name: 18078 · Schnecksville, PA
findings: ZIP 18078 (Schnecksville) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18078 (Schnecksville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18078 (Schnecksville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).
